module: Deferred vehicle deletion service in career: a "marked" vehicle is deleted (with a callback call) when it is more than 100 m from the camera and behind it, so that it disappears without the player seeing it. Inventory vehicles are removed via career_modules_inventory.removeVehicleObject, others via obj:delete(). The onUpdate hook is wired only while at least one vehicle is marked.
notes: Potential bug: onUpdate calls obj:getPositionXYZ() without checking that getObjectByID returned an object; a vehicle deleted elsewhere without going through onVehicleDestroyed would cause an error.
onExtensionLoaded returns false if the career is not active, which prevents the module from loading.
At each mission start (onAnyMissionChanged, started state), all marked vehicles are deleted immediately (without callback).

flagForDeletion.desc: Marks a vehicle for deferred deletion and activates the onUpdate loop.

clearFlags.desc: Removes a vehicle's marking (and unwires onUpdate if nothing remains).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: returns false if the career is not active.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook emitted on each mission state change: on "started" in career, deletes the marked vehicles.

onClientStartMission.desc: Level start hook: clears the list of marked vehicles.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook emitted when a vehicle is destroyed: removes its marking.
